name: What is the typical process for a home addition project?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for a home addition project?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical home addition project follows several key stages. It begins with an initial consultation to discuss your vision and needs, followed by the design phase where architectural plans are developed. Once plans are finalized, we move to the permitting stage, securing all necessary approvals from your local city (e.g., Orange, Lake Forest). The construction phase then commences, involving site preparation, foundation work, framing, roofing, utility installations (plumbing, electrical), and interior/exterior finishing. Throughout the process, we maintain open communication, conduct regular site meetings, and perform quality checks until the final walkthrough and project completion.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, design, permitting, and then construction, which includes site prep, framing, utilities, and finishing. Communication and quality checks are continuous.
